moments.text: Infrared sensor view looking down on grey sea with dark circular shading. A tiny white dot sits below and right of the crosshair, drifting slowly right.
A large ship crosses close and slanted, from the lower left corner to the top left; the dot stays below right of the crosshair.
The white dot drifts down toward the bottom edge of the frame.
The dot moves slightly left along the bottom edge to the end.

notes: Same footage as the last ~21 s of AARO-DOD_111426407 (PR-014).
